payload.text: I want to launch a vacation rental website that allows users to book accommodations for specific dates and times. I'm looking for two options: one for individual use and another as a SaaS application where hosts and guests can register. This would involve a master panel to manage host accounts, with each host having their own individual access panel. The application must be fully customizable (home, hero, etc.) from the dashboard. It should also include a real-time chat with a conversation history, user status indicators (online/typing), and a login page. - Registration page (Users must validate their identity by uploading ID) - Social login options - Modern and vibrant design with color gradients - Dark/light mode with automatic system preference detection - Smooth animations - Fully responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop) - Hero page with background image and animations - Advanced search bar - Featured properties grid - Filters by category - Property details - Image gallery with carousel - Complete accommodation information - Booking panel with price calculation - Review system - Host information User Dashboard • Booking view • Personal statistics • Stay history • Profile management Administrator Dashboard • General statistics • Property CRUD • Booking management • Occupancy and revenue analysis • Property exploration • Complete property listing • Advanced filter system • Search by location, price, type • Favorites • Saved property management • Quick view of favorites Main scope • Payment gateway: Full integration for credit and debit cards, ideally with Stripe and Square. (Configurable from the dashboard) • Booking module: calendar with real-time availability, room blocking, and automatic user confirmations. • Administration panel: creation and editing of accommodations, payment and booking management, basic reports. • Essential sections such as catalog, user accounts, and booking history. • Best security practices (HTTPS, encrypted data) and a minimum of technical SEO. • Clear documentation for deployment and maintenance. Expected deliverables: • Complete source code and production-ready database. • Installation and configuration instructions. • Details of the stack used and estimated development time. I value prior experience, payment integrations, and booking systems. Please share your portfolio or examples of similar projects and clarify any questions you may have about the requirements. Images of the expected design are attached for some sections. Suggested technologies: Backend/API: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, WebSockets, Tokens, JWT, Firebase storage; Frontend: Next.js

**Considering SaaS Viability**

I'm currently focused on the feasibility of a multi-tenant vacation rental platform, with SaaS potential. I'm exploring the architecture required for Master Admin and Host panels, along with guest/host registration features, including ID validation. I'm also considering the implications of a fully customizable CMS for the home page and hero sections.


**Adding New Features**

I've been concentrating on the new feature set for this project. Specifically, the real-time chat functionality, comprehensive search and filter options, a detailed property grid, and a streamlined booking panel with price calculations. I'm also planning to integrate a robust review system, image galleries, and informative dashboards for various user roles. Payment integration is also in the pipeline. I will be sure to incorporate Gemini API for AI-powered features.


**Developing Architectural Structure**

I'm currently fleshing out the application's file structure and key components, incorporating my recent design decisions.  I've defined roles using an enum for SaaS capability and started implementing global state management with context. I've designed the foundational components for a customizable hero, real-time chat (with AI integration via Gemini), and a visually vibrant interface. The components include Navbar, Footer, property cards, and various pages like Home, property details, and dashboards for Guest, Host, and Super Admin roles.


**Incorporating UI/UX Enhancements**

I'm focused on the UI/UX improvements. I plan to use page transitions and card hover effects for smooth user experience. Dark mode is also on my list, to enhance accessibility and visual appeal. I've also incorporated a user-friendly property analysis tool and a chatbot to serve as a virtual concierge. I need to mock the "ID Upload" feature. Multi-tenancy will be achieved with a "Master Panel" vs "Host Panel" role verification. I've also outlined several key files for the project's structure.


**Implementing Key Features**

I'm currently focused on implementation, starting with critical files like PropertyDetails.tsx and Chat.tsx. I'm also refining the customization approach, introducing a `SiteConfig` object in the global state, enabling SuperAdmins to modify site-wide elements. I've validated constraints such as TypeScript, ESM, and Tailwind usage. I will ensure Gemini 3 Flash and Recharts integration. As requested, I'll follow the system guidelines and deliver a React SPA instead of Next.js, while retaining a modern Next.js aesthetic. Let's get building!
